يستتفهون (form X)
# يَسْتَتْفِهُونَ (yastatfihūna) /jas.tat.fi.huː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
# يُسْتَتْفَهُونَ (yustatfahūna) /jus.tat.fa.huː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَتْفَهَ (istatfaha)
